units.source_text: “那沙子不知从哪儿进来的，迎风的恶劣天气，

en.t: I do not know where that sand comes in from, but in bad weather when the wind is blowing this way,

units.source_text: 一早一晚各一次，要是不去弄掉天花板上的沙子，

en.t: once in the morning and once at night, if I do not clear the sand off the ceiling,

units.source_text: 那沙子便积得很厚，天花板肯定承受不了的……”

en.t: the sand piles up so thick that the ceiling surely could not bear it...
